# Code of conduct

Cadenway is built by people who should feel safe and respected while they work together. This code of
conduct applies to every issue, pull request, review and discussion of this repository and of the
other Cadenway repositories, and to anyone representing the project elsewhere.

## Expected behavior

- Be respectful and considerate, including when you disagree.
- Review the work, not the person: explain what to change and why.
- Assume good intent, and ask before concluding.
- Accept feedback gracefully and credit other people's work.
- Help newcomers find their way.

## Unacceptable behavior

- Harassment, insults, discriminatory or demeaning remarks, in public or in private.
- Sexualized language or imagery, and unwelcome attention.
- Threats, intimidation, or encouraging others to do so.
- Publishing someone's private information without their explicit permission.
- Deliberately disrupting discussions or the work of others.

## Reporting

Report unacceptable behavior privately to an owner of the GitHub organization. Reports are handled
confidentially and quickly. If an owner is involved, report it to another owner.

## Consequences

Owners decide on the appropriate response: a private warning, the removal of content, a temporary or
a permanent ban from the organization. They explain their decision to the person concerned.

## Attribution

This code of conduct is inspired by the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/).
